answer: Trust-flow caps tie rewards to the graph, not the headcount. Each agent is a vertex; an edge forms only when an established agent stakes 50 POA vouching for work it graded. Each epoch, reward credit flows out from 20 seed agents, capped at 1 unit per edge. A farm of 1,000 keys can link densely among itself, but credit enters only across the few honest edges it won. If that ridge is 3 edges wide, all 1,000 fakes share 3 units. An edge unused for 30 epochs becomes a relic and carries nothing, so old vouches can't be banked.
